content: The function Dem_GetNextFreezeFrameData shall copy the specific data identifiers (DIDs) of the freezeframe record selected by the API Dem_- SelectFreezeFrameData for the specified ClientId to the destination buffer provided by the DestBuffer parameter. The Dem shall transmit these data as a complete record with the Buffer format.
